-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Demon Light Sword of Judgment.png  |title= Demon Light Magic |kanji= 魔光魔法 |romaji= Makō Mahō |english= Demon Light Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Patolli }} {{Nihongo|Demon Light Magic|魔光魔法|Makō Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of Light Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of light at will. This black-colored light makes spells faster, stronger, and denser than their Light Magic counterparts and more effective
